SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS average_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio
FROM scans AS s
JOIN sites AS si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
WHERE s.scancount > 11
GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor
ORDER BY average_compression_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
